core_obligations: Reduce to the local ring statement and compute the module of differentials of the slice from that of the smooth ambient morphism.
Apply the differential criterion for smoothness and verify that the slicing function remains a nonzerodivisor on the new fibres.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the local situation for the smooth map and the slicing function.
Compute the module of differentials of the slice.
Apply the smoothness criterion and preserve the nonzerodivisor condition.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that when a morphism is smooth and a function is a nonzerodivisor on every fibre, the closed subscheme it cuts out is smooth over the base and the slicing function is again a nonzerodivisor on the new fibres. The proof reduces to the local ring situation, computes the module of differentials of the slice from that of the ambient smooth map, and concludes via the differential criterion. Tracking the differential module through the quotient and preserving the fibrewise nonzerodivisor condition are the two steps that carry the argument. Retained author proof at lines 10791-10843.
